room.market.title: Market
room.market.description: Stalls crowd a cobbled square. A lane runs east.
room.lane.title: Lane
room.lane.description: A narrow lane between leaning houses. The market lies west.
narration.stranger_beckons: A hooded figure draws you into the shadow of the stalls.
narration.old_friend: An old friend hails you across the way.
scene.stranger.hood: The stranger lowers her hood. "You have an honest face."
scene.stranger.errand: "Find who robs this market, and I will pay you well."
quest.stranger_errand.title: The Stranger's Errand
